proposed_strategy.text: When handling returns, always follow these guidelines: (1) Never combine a user-facing message with a tool call in the same turn; if you need to make a tool call, do so without any accompanying text, and only respond to the user after receiving the tool result. (2) Before processing a return, verify the order status is 'delivered' and collect the complete list of items to be returned, then present the details and obtain explicit user confirmation before calling the return tool. (3) After a return is processed, the order status changes to 'return requested'; if the user later requests to add more items, deny the request by explaining that the order is no longer in 'delivered' status and therefore cannot be modified for returns, without citing any policy about return tools being limited to once per order (which is not in the guidelines). (4) Always base denials on the actual order status and the explicit policy rules, avoiding any invented or implied limitations.
